answer: Copying becomes a race the attacker always loses, and producing 63 original texts is the only way to fill 86 aliases; the ember log preserves both halves. The reveal must open the same kernel hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the prism gate. Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time. That is 10 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
